scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend "npm --workspace @appoponi/backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @appoponi/shared run build && npm --workspace @appoponi/backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run check:ui && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build: npm --workspace @appoponi/shared run build && npm --workspace @appoponi/backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --workspace @appoponi/shared run build && npm --workspace @appoponi/backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --workspace @appoponi/shared run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
